## src/SharpProof.Attributes/ResourceUpperBoundAttribute.cs

[Source](../../src/SharpProof.Attributes/ResourceUpperBoundAttribute.cs)

```text
namespace SharpProof.Attributes;

/// <summary>Identifies a resource measured by a static bound.</summary>
public enum ResourceMetric
{
    /// <summary>No resource metric; this value cannot declare a bound.</summary>
    Unspecified = 0,
    /// <summary>Total body entries across modeled loops, including admitted calls.</summary>
    LoopBodyEntries = 1,
    /// <summary>Number of managed primitive-array allocations.</summary>
    ArrayAllocations = 2,
    /// <summary>Total primitive-array elements allocated, independent of element width.</summary>
    AllocatedElements = 3,
    /// <summary>Fresh managed instance bytes under the reviewed CoreCLR 8.0.32 x64 source storage model.</summary>
    /// <remarks>Requires a captured x64 target and an explicit trusted layout dependency in proof evidence.</remarks>
    AllocatedBytes = 4,
    /// <summary>Peak logically live owned bytes excluding the final returned graph, on normal completion.</summary>
    /// <remarks>Uses the finite strong-reachability and reviewed runtime-layout models, not GC collection times.</remarks>
    PeakAuxiliaryBytes = 5,
    /// <summary>Owned bytes reachable from the returned value on normal completion.</summary>
    /// <remarks>Borrowed input storage is outside the owned-storage model.</remarks>
    RetainedBytes = 6,
    /// <summary>Maximum simultaneous logical source activations, without tail-call elimination.</summary>
    SourceActivationDepth = 7,
    /// <summary>Logical source activation storage under the eight-byte variable-slot model.</summary>
    /// <remarks>Excludes JIT frame layout, evaluation temporaries and runtime/native stack usage.</remarks>
    SourceStackBytes = 8
}

/// <summary>Requires a native proof of a resource upper bound.</summary>
/// <remarks>
/// The mathematical bound is constant plus coefficient times the nonnegative entry size.
/// A size is an Int32/Int64 parameter name or an array/string parameter followed by .Length.
/// Negative scalars and null arrays/strings have entry size zero. Cumulative metrics include exceptional execution prefixes.
/// This is a static contract; it does not execute the method or insert runtime checks.
/// Unsupported operations produce Unknown. These metrics do not measure elapsed time,
/// physical heap residency or stack memory. Logical peak/retained metrics describe normal completion under their declared model.
/// Byte bounds are conditional on the published runtime layout model.
/// </remarks>
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method, AllowMultiple = true, Inherited = false)]
public sealed class ResourceUpperBoundAttribute : Attribute
{
    /// <summary>Creates a constant or linear mathematical resource bound.</summary>
    /// <param name="metric">The resource to bound.</param>
    /// <param name="constant">The nonnegative constant term.</param>
    /// <param name="sizeParameter">The entry parameter name or array length, or null for a constant bound.</param>
    /// <param name="coefficient">The positive size coefficient, or zero for a constant bound.</param>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentOutOfRangeException">A metric or numeric term is invalid.</exception>
    /// <exception cref="ArgumentException">The size name and coefficient do not form a linear bound.</exception>
    public ResourceUpperBoundAttribute(ResourceMetric metric, long constant, string? sizeParameter = null, long coefficient = 0)
    {
        if (metric == ResourceMetric.Unspecified || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ResourceMetric), metric))
        { throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(metric)); }
        if (constant < 0)
        { throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(constant)); }
        if (coefficient < 0)
        { throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(coefficient)); }
        if (sizeParameter is null ? coefficient != 0 : string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sizeParameter) || coefficient == 0)
        { throw new ArgumentException("A linear bound requires a size name and a positive coefficient.", nameof(sizeParameter)); }
        Metric = metric;
        Constant = constant;
        SizeParameter = sizeParameter;
        Coefficient = coefficient;
    }

    /// <summary>Gets the resource metric.</summary>
    /// <value>The resource measured by this contract.</value>
    public ResourceMetric Metric { get; }
    /// <summary>Gets the nonnegative constant term.</summary>
    /// <value>The nonnegative constant term in the mathematical bound.</value>
    public long Constant { get; }
    /// <summary>Gets the entry size name, or null for a constant bound.</summary>
    /// <value>The scalar parameter name or array/string length, or null for a constant bound.</value>
    public string? SizeParameter { get; }
    /// <summary>Gets the nonnegative size coefficient.</summary>
    /// <value>The positive size multiplier, or zero for a constant bound.</value>
    public long Coefficient { get; }
}
```

```text
namespace SharpProof.Attributes;

/// <summary>Identifies ambient capabilities tracked by effect analysis.</summary>
/// <remarks>
/// This is a closed bitmask; combine declared members with bitwise OR. There is no public All member.
/// Allowing a capability does not grant an operating-system permission. None selects an empty allowance;
/// it does not establish a proof unless the selected body/call evidence satisfies the configured policy.
/// </remarks>
[Flags]
public enum SharpProofCapability
{
    /// <summary>Uses no tracked ambient capability.</summary>
    None = 0,
    /// <summary>Uses general input or output.</summary>
    IO = 1 << 0,
    /// <summary>Reads from the file system.</summary>
    FileRead = 1 << 1,
    /// <summary>Writes to the file system.</summary>
    FileWrite = 1 << 2,
    /// <summary>Uses a network resource.</summary>
    Network = 1 << 3,
    /// <summary>Uses the process console.</summary>
    Console = 1 << 4,
    /// <summary>Uses process-management facilities.</summary>
    Process = 1 << 5,
    /// <summary>Reads or writes process environment state.</summary>
    Environment = 1 << 6,
    /// <summary>Uses the Windows registry.</summary>
    Registry = 1 << 7,
    /// <summary>Reads time or timer state.</summary>
    Clock = 1 << 8,
    /// <summary>Uses a source of randomness.</summary>
    Randomness = 1 << 9,
    /// <summary>Uses reflection facilities.</summary>
    Reflection = 1 << 10,
    /// <summary>Uses synchronization facilities.</summary>
    Synchronization = 1 << 11,
    /// <summary>Crosses a native-code boundary.</summary>
    NativeInterop = 1 << 12
}
```

## src/SharpProof.Attributes/SharpProofEffect.cs

[Source](../../src/SharpProof.Attributes/SharpProofEffect.cs)

```text
namespace SharpProof.Attributes;

/// <summary>Identifies effects tracked by SharpProof summaries.</summary>
/// <remarks>
/// This is a closed bitmask: combine declared members with bitwise OR, without inventing bits or an All value.
/// Flags are independent; Throws does not imply Allocates. None is an empty declaration and, by itself, is not a complete proof.
/// These describe modeled behavior, not operating-system permissions or runtime enforcement.
/// </remarks>
[Flags]
public enum SharpProofEffect : long
{
    /// <summary>Performs no tracked effect.</summary>
    None = 0,
    /// <summary>Reads state reachable from the receiver.</summary>
    ReadsReceiverState = 1L << 0,
    /// <summary>Reads state reachable from an argument.</summary>
    ReadsArgumentState = 1L << 1,
    /// <summary>Reads captured state.</summary>
    ReadsCapturedState = 1L << 2,
    /// <summary>Reads static managed state.</summary>
    ReadsStaticState = 1L << 3,
    /// <summary>Reads ambient state.</summary>
    ReadsAmbientState = 1L << 4,
    /// <summary>Writes state reachable from the receiver.</summary>
    WritesReceiverState = 1L << 5,
    /// <summary>Writes state reachable from an argument.</summary>
    WritesArgumentState = 1L << 6,
    /// <summary>Writes captured state.</summary>
    WritesCapturedState = 1L << 7,
    /// <summary>Writes static managed state.</summary>
    WritesStaticState = 1L << 8,
    /// <summary>Writes ambient state.</summary>
    WritesAmbientState = 1L << 9,
    /// <summary>Allocates managed storage.</summary>
    Allocates = 1L << 10,
    /// <summary>May let an exception escape.</summary>
    Throws = 1L << 11,
    /// <summary>Uses synchronization.</summary>
    Synchronizes = 1L << 12,
    /// <summary>Uses nondeterministic behavior.</summary>
    UsesNondeterminism = 1L << 13,
    /// <summary>Uses native code.</summary>
    UsesNativeCode = 1L << 14,
    /// <summary>Uses reflection.</summary>
    UsesReflection = 1L << 15
}
```

## src/SharpProof.Fuzz/FuzzOptions.cs

[Source](../../src/SharpProof.Fuzz/FuzzOptions.cs)

```text
using System.Globalization;

namespace SharpProof.Fuzz;

internal sealed record FuzzOptions(int Cases, int Seed, int MaximumParallelism)
{
    public const int DefaultCases = 1000;
    public const int MaximumCases = 1_000_000;
    public const int DefaultSeed = 0x5A17;
    public const int MaximumAllowedParallelism = 4;
    public const int DefaultMaximumParallelism = MaximumAllowedParallelism;

    public static FuzzOptions Parse(IReadOnlyList<string> arguments)
    {
        if (arguments == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(arguments));
        }

        var cases = DefaultCases;
        var seed = DefaultSeed;
        var maximumParallelism = DefaultMaximumParallelism;

        for (var index = 0; index < arguments.Count; index++)
        {
            var argument = arguments[index];
            if (argument is "--help" or "-h")
            {
                throw new FuzzUsageException("");
            }

            if (index + 1 >= arguments.Count)
            {
                throw new FuzzUsageException("Missing value for " + argument + ".");
            }

            var value = arguments[++index];
            switch (argument)
            {
                case "--cases":
                    cases = ParsePositive(value, argument);
                    if (cases > MaximumCases)
                    {
                        throw new FuzzUsageException(
                            "--cases cannot exceed the limit of " +
                            MaximumCases.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) +
                            ".");
                    }
                    break;
                case "--seed":
                    if (!int.TryParse(
                            value,
                            NumberStyles.Integer,
                            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                            out seed))
                    {
                        throw new FuzzUsageException("--seed requires a 32-bit integer.");
                    }

                    break;
                case "--max-parallelism":
                    maximumParallelism = ParsePositive(value, argument);
                    if (maximumParallelism > MaximumAllowedParallelism)
                    {
                        throw new FuzzUsageException(
                            "--max-parallelism cannot exceed the limit of " + MaximumAllowedParallelism.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ".");
                    }

                    break;
                default:
                    throw new FuzzUsageException("Unknown option: " + argument + ".");
            }
        }

        return new FuzzOptions(cases, seed, maximumParallelism);
    }

    private static int ParsePositive(string value, string option)
    {
        option = RepositoryParameterGuard.NotNull(option, nameof(option));
        if (!int.TryParse(
                value,
                NumberStyles.Integer,
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                out var parsed) ||
            parsed <= 0)
        {
            throw new FuzzUsageException(option + " requires a positive integer.");
        }

        return parsed;
    }
}

internal sealed class FuzzUsageException : Exception
{
    public FuzzUsageException()
    {
    }

    public FuzzUsageException(string message)
        : base(message)
    {
        System.ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(message, nameof(message));
    }

    public FuzzUsageException(string message, Exception innerException)
        : base(message, innerException)
    {
        System.ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(innerException, nameof(innerException));
        System.ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(message, nameof(message));
    }
}
```
